name: Rocket Sticker
summary: Flat rocket blasting diagonally up with flame and puffs, for launch, growth and fast moments.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 420 px across at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: rocket colour; one darker shade is added for depth

params.name: anim
params.note: idle motion from p.f; flame flickers and puffs exhaust

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror left-right (launches up and to the left)

author: krakujs
